text: Security is a crucial part of web development, and developers must take it seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and servers. Second, strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor authentication, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Third, input validation is essential because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, so they can prevent attacks before they happen. By following these basic rules, developers can build safer websites and protect users' personal information.
